semantics.meaning: Authorization/governance parent relationship used by AccessCore policy where applicable.
semantics.separation_rule: AC parent is independent from IAM parent.
semantics.ownership_rule: AC parent does not become semantic owner of child instance data/modules merely by parentage.
semantics.network_rule: AC parent is not inferred from transport topology.
semantics.authorization_rule: Rights still resolve through explicit AccessCore policy; parentage alone is not blanket permission.
semantics.resolution_rule: Parent target resolves by explicit canonical identity.
semantics.change_rule: Changing AC parent is an explicit governed configuration change.

invariants.rule: Instance identity, configuration parents, activation state and reload behavior remain explicit and do not derive authority from UI or runtime state.
